summary: The ProgramCourseInfo class is part of the HSPnet.UserControls.PlacementRequestDetails namespace and manages various aspects of program course information within the system. It includes functionality for loading, displaying, editing, and saving program and course details related to placement requests.
purpose: The purpose of ProgramCourseInfo is to manage program and course information in relation to placement requests, enabling the setup, display, and modification of related data such as course names, program types, duration, and placements.

workflows.name: Course Setup and Display
steps: Load user session and check for editable screen conditions.
Setup and bind data to various controls such as Program, Course, Cohort, Placement Type, and Duration.
Handle control visibility and interactivity based on user permissions and data conditions.
Provide links to detailed views when applicable and manage hyperlink states.

business_rules: Course hyperlinks are only active if a profile exists or the user can edit.
Save/Cancel buttons are visible if any data fields are editable.
Display program and placement type as mandatory when applicable.
Ensure duration values are positive and non-zero when edited.
validations: Validate that course duration hours are not negative or zero.
Ensure course names and other mandatory fields are not empty during edit sessions.
conditions: Conditions on visibility of placement and program types based on user permissions.
Rendering of editable fields dependent on user type and screen state.
system_behavior: Dynamic control of UI elements like hyperlinks and buttons based on session data and user roles.
Javascript initialization and execution for client-side components.
Server-side handling for button click events to process updates and redirections.
exceptions: Display error messages for invalid duration entries.
Handle non-existent course profiles gracefully by disabling related links.
